mathematical_contract.definitions: For homogeneous tangent numerator H, S=H dot H and Q=d W^2(H'_x H_y-H'_y H_x).
mathematical_contract.selected_cusp: Construction requires the certified regular selected branch S>0, Q<0, and Q^2=S^3 at the retained isolated source parameter.
mathematical_contract.normal_reduction: The selected cusp identities imply 1/sqrt(S)=-S/Q and therefore left normal N=(H_y S/Q,-H_x S/Q).
mathematical_contract.point_image: For any requested shared-source parallel distance c, x=(XQ+c H_y S W)/(WQ) and y=(YQ-c H_x S W)/(WQ); W=1 is the polynomial specialization.
mathematical_contract.domain: Q<0 proves Q is nonzero. Because Q contains W^2, it also proves the affine source weight is nonzero at the cusp, so WQ is a valid denominator.
mathematical_contract.non_cusp: A certified source singularity, opposite signed-curvature branch, or nonzero cusp residual returns Decided(None); unresolved predicates remain Classification::Uncertain.
mathematical_contract.retention: Hypersolve coordinate transformation is an optional representation optimization. If it declines one coordinate after the cusp/domain proof, Hypercurve retains the exact parameter and rational coordinate polynomials instead of discarding the exact point.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT accepts only its exact predicate proofs. APPROXIMATE_512 may terminate an otherwise unresolved predicate at its configured 512-bit boundary, while returned coordinates remain the exact retained rational expression selected by that policy.

capability.intentional_boundary: The point substrate remains crate-internal until a complete algebraic join carrier participates in intersection, bounds, ray classification, arrangement, and export. No partial carrier is admitted to CurveRegion2.

focused_capability.method: eleven release unit-test processes pinned to CPU 11 under perf stat; each process isolates the general cubic cusps, constructs inner/center/outer images under both policies, proves all geometric identities, and rejects one irrational non-cusp
focused_capability.interpretation: This is a new exact capability baseline, not a comparison with a parent approximation. It includes degree-heavy independent identity assertions and test-harness overhead.
